thread:
lucy-sales: Heads-up 60; Northwell Health asked for SOC 2 + ISO27001 artifacts for the POC, plus a pen-test attestation and a signed proof-of-deletion for a set of staging logs. They want artifacts in 4 business days. Can we do that? cc @omar-se @natalie-sec

omar-se: 4 days doable if they accept presigned upload links and redacted artifacts. If they want us to push directly into their dataroom it will add ops time.

natalie-sec: We can produce the SOC2 control map, ISO scope, and a sanitized network diagram. For logs that contain patient IDs we need their redaction list or we'll return hashed fields instead. Also: pen-test attestation is fine, we can't share raw exploit traces without an NDA addendum.

kevin-ops: For the deletion proof we use this flow: (1) inventory objects, (2) perform deletion job, (3) produce a manifest file of deleted keys, (4) compute SHA256 over manifest, (5) GPG-sign the manifest and timestamp it. Usually ~3-5 hours once we have exact keys.

legal-amy: We'll prepare a standard pen-test attestation and a SOC2 bridge letter. For deletion proofs we'll approve a statement that we executed deletion procedures and provide the signed manifest. We can't guarantee deletion on copies outside our control (backups, third-party caches) 60; we'll include that caveat. NDA addendum required for any console screenshots or HSM logs.

lucy-sales: Good. They also asked for BYOK details and a short runbook for key rotation to satisfy their security team. Can we include an excerpt?

natalie-sec: Yes 60; we can provide a sanitized key rotation excerpt and KMS origin metadata (e.g., AWS KMS - HSM-backed CMKs, rotation cadence, key policy patterns). If they request imported key material (BYOK import) that is a heavier ops path and will need scheduled maintenance windows.

omar-se: Pricing note: if they move from Hosted to Dedicated for the POC (for SLA or isolation reasons) add a monthly delta and a provisioning lead time of ~10 business days. I'll prepare a short delta estimate for the pack.

kevin-ops: For presigned S3 uploads here's a Python snippet we usually send to customers (48h TTL):
```python
import boto3
s3 = boto3.client('s3')
post = s3.generate_presigned_post('redwood-evidence', 'northwell-poc/upload-12345.zip', ExpiresIn=172800)
print(post)
```
We enforce server-side encryption and restrict uploads to the namespace `northwell-poc/<id>/`

infra-bot: Created path: s3://redwood-evidence/northwell-temp-172999-12345, presigned TTL=48h, lifecycle=7d, SSE=AES256 enforced. Ticket EVID-2038 opened.

lucy-sales: Action items: (1) Omar -> short Dedicated vs Hosted delta and ETA (2) Natalie -> sanitized SOC2 map, ISO scope, sanitized rotation runbook excerpt, pen-test attestation draft (3) Kevin -> presigned links + deletion job flow once manifest is provided (4) Legal Amy -> SOC2 bridge + NDA addendum + deletion attestation template.

omar-se: I'll drop a 2-line delta in ~30m.

natalie-sec: Starting the sanitized docs now. Please send the redaction CSV listing fields to withhold (e.g., patient_id, email, uri). If they can't provide that we will hash PII fields instead.

kevin-ops: Note on deletion manifest: we can provide both the manifest and the SHA256(GZIP(manifest)) along with a detached GPG signature. Example statement we'll attach: "Redwood executed object deletion for keys listed in manifest v1.0. SHA256(manifest) = <hex>. Manifest GPG-signed by kevin-ops on <date>."

legal-amy: Drafting templates now. Also including redaction appendix options: either they supply a CSV of fields to holdback or we produce a hashed substitute for sensitive fields.

lucy-sales: I just messaged Northwell: prefer presigned link, will send redaction CSV by EOD, they want the deletion proof to include GPG signature. They asked whether SOC2 bridge can be backdated to cover last 90 days.

natalie-sec: We can provide a SOC2 bridge letter covering the requested 90-day window; I'll tag the appropriate dates.

omar-se: Pricing delta: Hosted POC = baseline, Dedicated small pool (2x GPU equiv) approx +$Yk/mo, provisioning ETA 10 business days. Attached as a short doc in our drive (link).

kevin-ops: Once we have the CSV of object keys we'll run the deletion job. Please confirm if they want us to retain a copy for internal audit (we can, for 30 days) or to delete immediately. That affects lifecycle.

lucy-sales: Northwell replied: "Please delete immediately after signed manifest; do not retain copies. Redaction CSV inbound within 4 hours."

legal-amy: We'll include the standard caveat about third-party backups in the deletion attestation. Also prepping a minimal NDA addendum in case they ask for HSM logs.

natalie-sec: :white_check_mark: I'll post the sanitized SOC2 control map and rotation excerpt by EOD tomorrow.

omar-se: :white_check_mark: delta doc pasted in thread (drive link).

kevin-ops: :white_check_mark: presigned path ready; waiting for manifest CSV to run deletion and sign manifest. Ticket EVID-2038 assigned to kevin-ops.

legal-amy: :white_check_mark: pen-test attestation + SOC2 bridge + deletion attestation templates will be in this thread in ~5 hours.

lucy-sales: Thanks team. I'll assemble the pack once items are in here and then upload the sanitized bundle to the presigned path. Ping me if anything slips.
